claim: To enable AWS WAF for an API, you first use the AWS WAF console, AWS SDK, or CLI to create a web ACL that contains the desired combination of AWS WAF managed rules and your own custom rules, and then associate the AWS WAF web ACL with an API stage, by using the AWS WAF console, AWS SDK, CLI, or the API Gateway console.

evidence.quote: To enable AWS WAF for your API, you need to do the following:
Use the AWS WAF console, AWS SDK, or CLI to create a web ACL that contains the desired combination of AWS WAF managed rules and your own custom rules.
Associate the AWS WAF web ACL with an API stage. You can do this by using the AWS WAF console, AWS SDK, CLI, or by using the API Gateway console.
